sol1-gale-crater.caption: Curiosity's view of the layered buttes of Mount Sharp inside Gale Crater.
sol1-gale-crater.altText: A wide view of a Martian landscape with a tall, layered mountain in the distance under a hazy sky.

sol2-mars-night.caption: A blue-tinged Martian sunset captured by the Curiosity rover's Mastcam.
sol2-mars-night.altText: The Sun dips below the Martian horizon, surrounded by a faint blue glow in a dusty sky.

sol3-dust-devil.caption: A local dust devil swirling across the Martian landscape in Gale Crater.
sol3-dust-devil.altText: A ghostly, swirling column of dust moves across a rocky Martian plain.

sol4-rover-drill.caption: Curiosity drills into the Martian surface. The soil contains tiny amounts of trapped water, not solid ice.
sol4-rover-drill.altText: A small, perfectly round hole drilled into a flat, grayish Martian rock, surrounded by gray rock powder.

sol5-earth-view.caption: Earth appears as the brightest point of light in the Martian twilight sky.
sol5-earth-view.altText: A dark, dusky Martian sky with a single bright speck of light, which is the planet Earth.

sol6-solar-flare.caption: A powerful solar flare erupting from the Sun, as captured by NASA's Solar Dynamics Observatory.
sol6-solar-flare.altText: A bright flash of extreme ultraviolet light erupting from the fiery, glowing surface of the Sun.

sol7-worn-wheel.caption: Close-up of Curiosity's worn aluminum wheels, showing damage from the rugged Martian terrain.
sol7-worn-wheel.altText: A metal rover wheel with several jagged holes and cracks resting on rocky Martian soil.

sol8-iss-leak.caption: The Robotic External Leak Locator on the International Space Station, used to sniff out tiny air leaks.
sol8-iss-leak.altText: A piece of robotic space station equipment used by astronauts to detect air leaks in orbit.

sol8-fresh-crater.caption: A fresh impact crater on Mars, photographed from orbit, showing a dark blast zone.
sol8-fresh-crater.altText: A satellite view of the Martian surface showing a small crater surrounded by a dramatic dark splatter mark.

sol9-mars-frost.caption: A thin layer of water frost covers the rocky Martian ground at Utopia Planitia during winter.
sol9-mars-frost.altText: A rocky, barren landscape coated in a very thin, bright white layer of morning frost.

sol10-exploration-future.caption: An artist's illustration of future astronauts exploring the lunar surface as a stepping stone to Mars.
sol10-exploration-future.altText: An artist's concept drawing of astronauts in modern spacesuits walking near a futuristic lunar base.
